source: engine selector: default "sqlite" stores data on the container disk — set "postgres" or "postgresdb" to use the managed PostgreSQL database

findings.message: The Dockerfile copies compiled, which the repository does not contain (a build step makes it before docker build). Deployz builds from the repository only. Add a Dockerfile that builds the app from source, or select another Dockerfile.

No health check route or container health check was found, so Deployz does not know when the app is ready. Expose a health route (for example /health) or add a container health check before deploying.
This app requires environment variables that have no value yet: DB_TYPE. Set them in the application's Configuration screen before deploying.
This app uses PostgreSQL but has no migration command; schema updates will not run on deploy.
